six_formula_steps.text: Multiply the actual numerical Fisher inequality by nonnegative one half and use order transitivity. Exact real arithmetic gives eta squared d divided by two. No division by d, eta or energy occurs, so zero-dimensional and zero-energy cases are retained.

six_formula_steps.text: Actual tests specialize eta=2, the positive unbounded measurable family eta(s)=s²+1 with y(s)=s v, and the zero-dimensional constant potential. The last test uses the real finrank zero upper bound and canonical KL nonnegativity to prove the actual finite KL real value is zero. T2 and the W2/FIRST step remain separate.
